This proof excludes every nested refinement of the old occurrences, so a successful successor must change an interval, add a true cross-chart transfer, or change another explicit premise.
stop_rule: Stop the nested-refinement route after the interval separator and its scope are independently checked, or if a counterexample/overlap invalidates the result. Do not launch scheduling or coefficient optimization after identity has been excluded in this model.
